title: WealthAbility Alternatives
keyLine: A CPA class teaches the map. Our plan writes 12 months. Neither one signs your return.
description: WealthAbility compared with Legacy Wealth Blueprint: a $197 class vs Preston Seo's written plan. Formula checkout was not printed. We do not print our tuition.
answer: WealthAbility is Tom Wheelwright's tax education company. He also wrote Tax-Free Wealth, the book many Rich Dad readers buy next. WealthAbility Live listed $197 a month on September 15, 2026. The Tax-Free Formula sales page we opened that day did not print a checkout price. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is Preston Seo's 12-month wealth plan: a written snapshot from your numbers, a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, and a CPA brief. He built that after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. Use WealthAbility if you want CPA-led class time. Use us if you want tax, debt, and investing in one written order. Hire a CPA when you need a signed Form 1040. We do not file. We do not publish our tuition here.

blocks.heading: What we actually sell
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about) founded Legacy Investing Show after leaving a corporate job and building a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. [Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) is the 12-month plan from that work: tax, debt, income, investing, and protection in one written order. You keep your CPA. We write a brief. They sign the return.
A tax class is a different job. An attorney membership is a third job. Do not buy all three unless you can name why.

blocks.heading: What WealthAbility sells
paragraphs: [WealthAbility Live](https://www.wealthability.com/wealthability-live/) is a monthly subscription. The page we opened listed $197 a month, two live sessions a month, a forum, and archives. It is hosted by Tom Wheelwright, CPA. Treat the lesson list as seller copy. We did not sit in the sessions.

The [Tax-Free Formula](https://www.wealthability.com/new-tax-free-formula/) page describes a digital course with modules on deductions, conversion, brackets, credits, and deferral. On September 15, 2026 that page did not print a checkout price in the text we could copy. If you saw $497 on an older screenshot, confirm the live offer. We will not invent it.
Tax-Free Wealth is the book. A book is not a filing position. Mentorship pages we opened did not publish a price. If someone quotes a five-figure WealthAbility coaching fee, ask for the live invoice.

blocks.heading: If you need a filer or an attorney instead
paragraphs: A certified public accountant or an enrolled agent can prepare and sign Form 1040. See [tax course vs hiring a CPA](/compare/tax-course-vs-cpa). Anderson Platinum is attorney and document membership at $3,495 to enroll plus $75 a month on the page we opened. Their FAQ said tax filing packages are not included. Full split: [Anderson Platinum vs our wealth plan](/compare/anderson-platinum-vs-tax-course).

blocks.label: W-2 limit in one line
paragraphs: After the 401(k) and HSA, most large tax ideas need a business or a rental. A $197 class that talks about entities will not lower a pure wage bill by itself. Fill the IRS buckets first. 2026 employee 401(k) deferral is $24,500 ([IRS IR-2025-111](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/401k-limit-increases-to-24500-for-2026-ira-limit-increases-to-7500)).

whoFits: You finished Tax-Free Wealth or a WealthAbility webinar and you are choosing a class versus a written wealth plan.
